top.summary: Initialization and Setup: The server module initializes by reading and caching the content of `SKILL.md` and potentially other instruction files.
Implementation of a utility to manage and validate the presence of required files for a local Codex marketplace setup.
Implementation of a file content parser utility (`parser.ts`) for smart file reading.
Implementation of a mechanism to integrate and configure a 'Claude-Mem' Cross-Session Memory (MCP) tool within IDE environments.
Rendering context headers based on user type (Human vs. Agent).
Rendering context footers based on user type (Human vs. Agent).
Defines core TypeScript interfaces for managing context, observations, and session summaries within a memory/context system.
Definition of allowed constants for server operations and topics within the Claude Memory service.
Implementation of a function to flush an HTTP response and execute subsequent asynchronous actions.
Defines TypeScript interfaces for data structures related to observations stored in an SQLite database.
Defines TypeScript interfaces for data structures related to prompt management within a SQLite context.
Data retrieval and querying for memory observations and summaries within a specific project context.
Implementation of a system to manage and persist 'Windsurf' hooks and project registry data.
Singleton pattern implementation for ModeManager to ensure a single instance across the application.
Implementing a structured, multi-step process for system shutdown to ensure graceful resource release.
Utility functions for managing and detecting the environment for Cursor integration.
Implementation of a one-time cleanup routine for version 12.4.3 of Claude Memory.
Implementing a local API key bootstrapping mechanism for the `server-beta` runtime.
Exporting core components for SQLite database management within the Claude Memory service.
Exporting prompts and related functionalities for SQLite integration within the memory service.
SQLite database interaction for retrieving file lists associated with a memory session.
Providing functions to query recent observation data from an SQLite database.
Implementation of a directory traversal utility (`walkDir`) for file system searching.
Definition of core data structures for memory/observation tracking within the domain.
Implementing logic for detecting and managing 'worktree' adoption within a repository structure.
